title: Chain and sprocket compound joint
goal: Couple continuous input-shaft and output-shaft rotation through a finite compliant transmission with phase-locked, saved-state-audited moving chain-path evidence.
constraints: The compound joint owns both shaft supports; duplicate standalone support capsules are forbidden.
Only the input shaft may expose a powered input port.
The active runtime variant is fixed at signed output/input ratio 2.0 and cannot be changed by editing JSON.
Sprocket solids, shaft axes, moving chain path, and physical collision bindings must remain consistent at every audited state.
Flexible interaction zones remain fixed in the authored-world frame at the frozen sprocket centers and axes; they do not follow rotating sprocket material or chain samples.
Matching sprocket overlap inside its fixed flexible zone is limited to the validator-derived public chain-and-sprocket geometry penetration cap; all deeper overlap fails.
The reduced model does not claim individual-link dynamics, individual tooth contact, or full flexible-body chain physics.

approval.basis: User approved compound transmissions as compound-joint supplements to primitive joint templates.
